continuity: Authority config is immutable except one exact proposal/intent nonce increment bound to its full transaction. Epoch mismatch rejects pending state.
value_rules: Governed reserves/locked stake never pay fees.
Only the funding input pays fee and new reserve contributions; all remaining value returns to its exact address.
One proposal/intent transition per transaction; ordered exact outputs prevent double satisfaction.
Receipt/proposal/intent mint and burn are exact across all policies; no VAMS mint supplies fictitious voting stake.
ledger_only_checks: Actual network/genesis/magic, collateral, minimum UTxO, minimum fee, script validity and applied budgets require ledger-equivalent preflight.
Plutus Address has no network nibble; it cannot independently validate a serialized address network.
migration: New compiled identities and explicit source review required. Do not admit legacy unqualified governance or reinterpret v1 datums; no deployment route activated. Timing-amended scripts need new compiled/applied identities and genesis review; no adoption of old lower-anchor states.
acceptance: Native check/tests, cross-script transactions, applied budgets, current-source independent review and actual custody manifest all pending.

redeemer_envelope.requirement: Every mint/spend entrypoint validates the outer version before dispatch. Old raw action constructor tags are not reinterpreted.

validity_interval.queue_time: finite upper bound, after envelope validation
validity_interval.minimum_delay_argument: For every inclusion t in [L,U), U+D-t >=D; conservative by at most validity width.
